LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/MH/11. Ministry of Agriculture, Land, Livestock and Irrigation Ref No.: 4/3/10/2014/LRB/09. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government has acquired the allotments of the land located between Rajamaha Vihara Road, Nawinna, Maharagama and Egodawaththa Road Boralesgamuwa are required for canal development in the paddy field, creating a water tank, water reserve and townscape development under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project. Description of the land acquired: The allotments of land in total extent of 1.0407 Hectares depicted as Lot Nos. 01 to 14 in Sheet No. 01, Block No. 03 of the Cadestral Map No. 521218 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village called Egodawaththa (Within the Urban Council limits of Kesbewa) in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 533 C of Egodawaththa in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of the Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Bandaradeniya Kumbura and Owita; Description: Owita; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0535 Hectare. 02.
